item.description: Macworld Apple unveiled a slew of new products this week, including not only the iPhone 17e and the new MacBook Neo, but also an updated iPad Air with the M4 chip. item.description: Macworld One of the flagship features of the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra phone is a new feature called Privacy Display.
